subject: Recap & next steps: POC trial planning + RACI (ClearLake Health)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>

Subject: Recap & next steps: POC trial planning + RACI (ClearLake Health)

Thanks for the time this morning, Hannah — good conversation. Below is a concise recap and proposed next steps so we can get the POC scheduled and staffed. Please confirm owners and timelines where noted.

High-level POC goal:
- Validate Redwood Inference for a 2-week trial serving patient-facing summaries in ClearLake’s Care Portal; success = 95th pct latency < 300ms for 512-token context, <1% quality/regression vs baseline.

Success criteria (proposal):
- Latency: 95th percentile under 300ms at expected throughput (50 concurrent sessions)
- Output quality: pass the shared eval set with no >5% regression on key intents
- Integration: ability to call Redwood API securely from ClearLake App (private VPC peering or secure endpoint)
- Cost: projected per-1k-token cost within agreed budget cap (TBD)

Evaluation plan / timeline:
- Week 0 (prep): exchange network requirements and service account + IP allowlist (Marissa/Aditya)
- Week 1 (POC start): deploy model variant, run synthetic load and begin evals (Aditya lead)
- Week 2 (trial evaluation): run user-traffic sample, review metrics, feedback loop (Lauren lead on success criteria and QA)
- Decision checkpoint: end of Week 2 -> proceed to pilot/expand or iterate

Ownership / RACI (initial draft) — please confirm or update:
- Redwood AM: Marissa Cole (overall engagement owner)
- Redwood CS/QA: Lauren Bishop (evaluation, success criteria, user feedback)
- Redwood Infra/Integration: Aditya Rao (network, service accounts, performance tuning)
- ClearLake App owner: TBD (who owns integration + feature toggles)
- ClearLake Infra/Network: TBD
- ClearLake Security / Compliance: TBD
- Procurement / Legal: TBD

Immediate asks for ClearLake:
1) Please confirm the internal owners for App/Infra/Security/Procurement so we can lock the RACI.
2) Share a primary technical contact for Aditya to coordinate connectivity and service account creation.
3) Confirm if VPC peering is required or if a secure public endpoint with allowlist will suffice.

Attachments: POC_RACI_Template.xlsx (attached) — we used this during the call; please edit and return.

Next steps (proposed):
- Hannah to confirm owners & procurement/contact info by Fri 3/27
- Aditya to send network requirements doc once owners confirmed
- Marissa to schedule kickoff for Mon 4/5 if owners available

Thanks again — happy to hop on a 15m call to finalize RACI if easier.

Best,

Thanks Hannah — looping Mark. A couple of technical clarifications from our side so we can size the environment and provide the correct network doc: 

1) Service account & auth: we’ll need a service account that can make outbound TLS calls to Redwood. If you prefer VPC peering, we’ll need subnet & CIDR details + peering contact.
2) Expected payloads: can you confirm typical prompt lengths (tokens) and expected average response length? We used 512 tokens in the call but want any variability noted.
3) Monitoring & logs: Redwood will provide token-level latency/cost breakdowns. If ClearLake requires logs forwarded into your SIEM, we can provide a secure webhook — please confirm retention and PII redaction policy.

Attached: network_requirements.pdf (stub) — this includes firewall rules, IPs, and optional peering checklist.

Proposal: once Mark confirms peering vs allowlist, I’ll update the checklist and target a tech kickoff the week of 4/5.

—Aditya
